title: Ability to add a webpage to the context
body:
Aider has an awesome feature where you can add a webpage to the context without copying & pasting the text from a browser, with `/web`. This is especially useful for API docs or for docs released after the knowledge cutoff.

Would be great to have something similar. (fine if it's with MCP or similar...)

TY!

(also sorry you're getting so many low quality Issues on the tracker, hopefully this one is helpful on the margin...)
author: max-sixty
